name: shfl_rowreduce
description: Isolates the 41_fmha softmax QUAD butterfly reduction: SHFL.BFLY ^1 then ^2 (clamp 0x1f) summing each 4-lane quad. Row-position-varying inputs make any lane-mapping error show as a wrong quad-sum at specific positions (mirrors 41_fmha residual rows {34,40}). Verifies lifter SHFL.BFLY lowering + wrapper lane mapping is bit-exact.
build_note: build host with -DSLIFTER_ARG_BASE=0x210 (sm_90 layout); default 0x160 is sm_80 and marshals args to the wrong const-bank offset
